summary: - **[key4hep/EDM4hep#528](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/528)** — Adds a `timeError` member to `TrackerHit3D`, `TrackerHitPlane`, `SenseWireHit` and the `TrackerHit` interface, and bumps the schema version; the previous schema is kept as `old_schemas/edm4hep_v6.yaml`. Per-hit time uncertainties can now replace the per-sensor placeholder resolutions used in 4D tracking, and producers and consumers of tracker hits should populate or read the new field.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1678](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1678)** — `Geant4EventAction` now throws if shared actions are used in single-threaded mode, instead of silently misbehaving (for example, writing events twice). The DDSim user output-plugin example is fixed for multi-threaded running. Steering files with user output plugins, such as those for IDEA and ALLEGRO, must use the common `kernel()` and set the shared flag correctly.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#122](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/122)** — Removes the legacy `ACTSSeededCKFTrackingAlg` along with `ACTSAlgBase`, `GeometryIdMappingTool` and `GeometryIdSelector`. Configurations still using them must switch to `CKFTrackingAlg`; v00-05 is the last tag that contains the old algorithm.

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#434](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/434)** — Fixes the `OverlayTiming` background cursor. `StartBackgroundEventIndex` no longer resets every event, so the same background events are no longer overlaid repeatedly. `AllowReusingBackgroundFiles` is now actually enforced, so jobs that relied on silent reuse of background files must set it explicitly or they will fail.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#72](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/72)** — Adds optional 4D (time-aware) tracking to `CKFTrackingAlg`. Hit time can be used as a CKF measurement dimension (`UseHitTimeInCKF`), resolutions are set per sensor via `HitTimeResolutions`, and seeding can apply an ACTS doublet time cut (`SeedFinding_DoubletTimeCutNSigma`). The PR also fixes a bug in the hit-count used by track filtering.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#72](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/72)** — ConformalTracking gains `ECalBarrelFaceSystemID` and `ECalEndcapFaceSystemID` properties, defaulting to the ILD/CLD values, so detectors with other system IDs such as ALLEGRO can extrapolate tracks to the calorimeter face. Tracks are now kept when no calorimeter intersection is found. `GaudiDDKalTest` also installs EM calorimeters identified by their type flags.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCC-config#403](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/403)** — Adds conformal tracking with silicon hits to the full ALLEGRO digi+reco sequence for both o1_v03 and o2_v01. It is enabled in the ctest sequences and relies on the k4Reco calorimeter-face changes.

- **[key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper#490](https://github.com/key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper/pull/490)** — Fixes Marlin random seeds not being refreshed per event in `MarlinProcessorWrapper`. New events were detected by comparing `LCEvent` pointers, and a new event is often allocated at the same address as the previous one, so processors kept reusing the same seeds. Wrapped Marlin processors that use random numbers, such as smearing or digitisation, were affected.

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#64](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/64)** — `GaussSmearVertex` and `FlatSmearVertex` now shift the HepMC3 event position together with the vertices. Previously beam particles stayed at (0,0,0) while the rest of the event was moved to the smeared interaction point.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1691](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1691)** — `HepMC3EventReader` now applies the HepMC3 length unit to the primary vertex x/y/z. Before this fix, vertex positions were wrong for input files using centimetres.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#109](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/109)** — Fixes `TracksFromGenParticles` reading uninitialized ECAL geometry when `ExtrapolateToECal=False`, which could give tracks calorimeter track states built from garbage geometry. Extrapolation now happens only when `ExtrapolateToECal` is set. Geometry lookup failures now return `FAILURE` instead of throwing, and the cellID is no longer truncated.

- **[HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter#286](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/286)** — Rewrites `PairCaloClustersPi0` to use a Boost.Graph maximum-matching algorithm (O(N³)) instead of an exponential exhaustive search. The algorithm becomes usable on hadronic events, where it previously exhausted memory. The pairs found are unchanged apart from output ordering.

Adds a customizable `LCCaloHit` extension point so calorimeter hits can be extended without changing PandoraSDK. No new functionality yet (lower priority).

Removes O(N²) loops in `CreateTruthLinks` using map-key iteration and a cellID index. Outputs, including ordering, are verified identical (lower priority).
Fixes phi-wrapping overflow with 128-bit long doubles on ARM, adds a missing include and suppresses a clang warning.
Fixes an unused lambda capture warning in `CaloDrivenClusterSeeding`.

Fixes uninitialized-variable warnings in `VTXdigitizerDetailed`.
Fixes `CollectionMerger` copy mode, rejects empty input lists that caused a segfault, and makes merging exception-safe (lower priority).
